tagline: Squat heavy while the bar looks after your shoulders.

videos.title: Safety Squat Bar Squat (SSB Squat): How To (Gym Shorts)

coaching.summary: Hold the handles of a safety squat bar with the pad across your upper back, squat to depth, then stand back up.
cues: Pull the handles down to keep the upper back tight under the pad.
Brace hard and keep the chest up, because the bar leans you forward.
Sit between the hips to full depth and drive straight up.
